description:
When this machine last started, what the run after it came to, and how long the
stack has failed to come back.

booted_at.description: When this machine last started, in seconds since the Unix epoch, where it says.

declined.description: Why a run after that start started nothing, where one did.

failed_boots.description: How many starts it has failed to come back after since then.

failing_since.description: Since when the stack has failed to come back, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

last_verified.description: The newest verification kept against any start.

verified.description: The verification kept against that start, where one ran after it.
